title: Compound Components Basics
description: Understand the compound components pattern for flexible APIs.

data.text: **Compound components** is a pattern where components share implicit state to work together. The parent component defines the structure, and child components handle specific parts.
The parent component provides context, and children consume it. This creates a flexible API where users can customize the composition.

data.title: Select Component
Benefits
data.text: Compound components provide flexibility (users control composition), readability (declarative API), and separation of concerns (each child handles one thing).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Parent provides context, children consume it
Each child has a single responsibility
data.takeaway: Compound components enable flexible, declarative APIs.
